text.tspan: One host kernel under all containers: patch it live, or make reboots not matter
Host kernel (shared by every container on the host: patch it once = patched for all; reboot it = all stop)
only critical CVEs, not every change
still reboot into the new kernel later
B · Rolling host replacement (preferred at scale)
Immutable: new patched AMI → ASG instance refresh
/ EKS managed node group update; kured automates
reboots one node at a time. Service stays up because
daemon.json "live-restore": true keeps containers running while dockerd restarts. It does NOT survive a kernel reboot.
uname -r still shows the old version after a live patch; that's expected.
